name: inspira-smooth-cursor
blurb: Custom cursor follows pointer with spring physics and rotates to track direction.
description: Replaces system cursor with a spring-animated custom cursor that tracks mouse position, rotates based on velocity, and scales briefly on movement.
use_when: Premium experiences or interactive galleries where a polished custom cursor enhances the feel of motion.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or mouse-free environments — cursor tracking requires an active pointer.
a11y: Replaces system cursor globally but does not affect keyboard focus or tab navigation. Rotation and position are visual only.
